name: Chilli Oil
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mix chile flakes and salt in a heat-proof bowl.
Mix 1 tbsp of the oil into the chile flake/salt mixture. This will prevent the chile from scorching when hot oil is added later.
Heat peanut oil to about 200°C (392°F). Small bubbles should form when poking a wooden chopstick into the oil.
Pour heated oil over chilli flake mixture and stir vigorously.
Allow to cool and store in a container.
